name: Meta Platforms
basis: each funding- or dividend-inclusive history is scaled to its own latest raw USD close

fundingForecast.displaySign: positive is earned by a perp long; negative is paid by a perp long

onchainSpot.preferenceBasis: all pages display separate CEX reported-volume and contract-backed DEX execution sections
onchainSpot.volumeSource: direct Binance, Bitget, Bybit, OKX, and Meteora venue APIs plus factory-verified PancakeSwap V3 pool-event volume indexed by DexScreener; DEX quote routes without indexed pool-event volume are excluded
onchainSpot.liquiditySource: direct CEX order books; direct Ethereum, Robinhood-chain, and PancakeSwap V3 quoter depth; direct Meteora pool state; and direct Jupiter executable round-trip quotes

peerMapping.justification: Primary hedge is the Nasdaq-100 rather than the S&P 500 because the peer block is concentrated in large-cap internet, software, platform, and AI factors; XYZ100 shows 21.944 USD millions of displayed 24-hour perp liquidity versus SP500 at 30.814 USD millions, and the lower liquidity is accepted for better factor alignment. Peer weights are positive, sum to 1.000, emphasize advertising and platform comparability first, and reduce names where business overlap is more indirect or displayed liquidity in USD millions is less aligned with META's 1.343 USD millions.

peers.name: Alphabet
peers.reason: Closest business match through digital advertising, consumer internet scale, and heavy AI investment; displayed 24-hour perp liquidity is 2.262 USD millions, comfortably above META at 1.343 USD millions.

peers.name: Microsoft
peers.reason: Mega-cap software, cloud, and AI platform exposure; its 1.386 USD millions of displayed 24-hour perp liquidity is close to META's 1.343 USD millions, but the revenue mix is less advertising-led than GOOGL.

peers.name: Apple
peers.reason: Large platform ecosystem with similar quality and mega-cap factor exposure; 1.422 USD millions of displayed 24-hour perp liquidity is near META, yet hardware reliance makes it less directly comparable than the advertising and AI software peers.

peers.name: Amazon
peers.reason: Large consumer internet and cloud platform with meaningful advertising economics, tempered by e-commerce and fulfillment mix; displayed liquidity is 0.462 USD millions, thinner than META, so the weight is held below the closest comparables.

peers.name: NVIDIA
peers.reason: NVIDIA captures the AI compute supply chain that drives Meta's capital expenditure sensitivity and market beta, and its deeper displayed 24-hour perp liquidity of 3.384 USD millions supports allocation despite less direct business overlap.

primary_index_hedge.name: Nasdaq-100
primary_index_hedge.reason: Nasdaq-100 is the primary hedge because it better matches META's megacap technology, internet, and AI factor mix than the broader S&P 500; its displayed 24-hour perp liquidity is 21.944 USD millions.

peerMapping.historyMethod: static initial Kimi weights applied to peer gross-total-return factors; peer closes forward-filled only across asynchronous exchange holidays; basket rebased to the target spot total-return level at the first fully covered date

earningsOptions.source: Schwab listed-options chain, FMP earnings calendars, and Sharadar adjusted prices

liquidityFilter.sides: OTM puts below spot and OTM calls above spot

model.name: liquid vertical-spread risk-neutral CDF
model.description: Liquid vertical spreads are used when the chain supplies at least four valid probability points; otherwise the nearest liquid ATM straddle supplies the expiration distribution. Earnings-date log distances are time-scaled from the first post-event expiration.
model.measure: risk-neutral, not a historical or physical forecast

historicalAnalysis.eventSource: SEC earnings release history with FMP historical calendar fallback
historicalAnalysis.method: Each current two-leg structure is translated into percentage-of-spot strikes and debit. Those same normalized strikes and today's debit percentage are replayed across prior earnings using the same calendar-day entry lead and post-event exit horizon. A profitable event requires expiration payoff greater than the original debit.
historicalAnalysis.limitation: Stock-path proxy using today's premium; historical option quotes, bid-ask execution, volatility repricing, early exercise, dividends, and transaction costs are not reconstructed.
